surface_value: depression affects 264 million people globally. suicide is the second-leading cause of death in those aged 15–29, and more than one in five people that live in a region impacted by conflict have a mental health condition.1 the human cost is vast, but so too is the impact on the economy: depression and anxiety cost the global economy more than $1tn per year.
